verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents a dedicated Sandbox API, test cards/account details, and SDK preproduction config flags for testing without production data (mangopay-docs-1, docs-2, docs-27, docs-26). This directly matches the story of testing in a sandbox without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond first-party docs, and explicit detail on data isolation guarantees between sandbox and production.
